tools.name: get_tier_list
tools.description: Champion tiers and public win/pick rates. Role uses champion class tags, not lane position. Paginated in site rank order.

tools.name: get_champion_build
tools.description: Measured item builds and skill orders for a champion. Accepts ids, names and aliases in all site locales.

tools.name: get_augment
tools.description: Public augment description, rarity, availability and statistics when published. Accepts localized names or ids.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search champion and augment names, aliases and augment descriptions across all site locales.

tools.name: get_top_combos
tools.description: Curated public combos ordered by editorial tier. These are suggestions, not measured win rates or vote rankings.

tools.name: get_patch_notes
tools.description: Site patch notes, newest by default; accepts 26.20 or 26-20. Changes may use English when a translation is unavailable.

tools.name: get_site_links
tools.description: Canonical ARAM Mayhem pages and the MCP setup guide.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
